claims.claim: Astera Labs identity remains reproducibly tied to CIK 0001736297 and NASDAQ ticker ALAB; the 2026 proxy and Q2 2026 10-Q are SEC primary filings from that issuer.
SEC filing facts and issuer IR disclosures are treated as issuer-origin evidence; multiple issuer URLs are not counted as independent corroborating origins.
September 17, 2026 market-price/market-cap observations are external market-data inputs and are kept distinct from issuer-origin operating evidence.

risks.risk: Issuer disclosures dominate operating/product evidence; external market feeds corroborate price/market-cap but do not independently validate competitive claims.

unknowns.unknown: No independent third-party source is used to upgrade issuer claims about future design-win conversion or market leadership.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $392.4M, +27% sequentially and +104% year over year; six-month revenue was $700.761M versus $351.367M in the prior-year period.
At June 30, 2026 Astera held $111.453M cash plus $1.142B marketable securities, supporting strong near-term liquidity.
Q2 2026 GAAP gross margin was 73.3%, down 250 bps year over year, primarily from product mix toward lower-margin hardware modules and warrant impact; six-month gross margin was 74.6%, down 80 bps.

The 2026 proxy documents six independent directors, fully independent audit/compensation/governance committees, a separate independent chair, annual compensation review, anti-hedging policy and planned performance-based RSUs for 2026.
ALAB closed September 17, 2026 at $293.56 with market capitalization about $50.93B; external feeds showed a trailing P/E around 145x, indicating a demanding valuation despite exceptional growth.
Management expected Scorpio X-Series to become the largest product family in Q3 2026; this remains a measurable execution checkpoint rather than realized filed Q3 evidence.

thesisQuality.basis: Exceptional realized growth, strong liquidity, expanding rack-scale AI connectivity portfolio and identifiable near-term product ramps support a strong thesis; valuation and substitution/concentration risks prevent a top-band score.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Filed Q2 revenue +104% YoY and +27% sequentially with six-month revenue nearly doubling; working-capital expansion and margin mix pressure prevent a maximum assessment.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: September 17 close of $293.56 and roughly $50.93B market cap / ~145x trailing P/E embed substantial expectations relative to current earnings; growth is exceptional but entry valuation offers limited margin of safety.

catalystScore.basis: Scorpio expected to become largest product family in Q3 and Leo sampling creates near-term measurable execution milestones, but realized conversion is not yet filed.

governancePower.basis: 2026 proxy documents six independent directors, independent key committees, separate independent chair, annual pay review, anti-hedging controls and movement toward performance-based RSUs; founder/operator influence and equity dilution remain considerations.

alignment2036.basis: Products directly address AI rack-scale connectivity and memory-capacity/utilization constraints.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Portfolio spans signal conditioning, fabric switching and memory connectivity, giving multiple attach paths across AI infrastructure.

bottleneckControl.basis: Scorpio and Leo target fabric bandwidth/latency and memory-utilization bottlenecks; merchant substitutes and vertical integration cap control.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Multi-protocol/platform breadth supports several AI infrastructure architectures, while hyperscaler/platform concentration and custom silicon reduce robustness.

substitutionResilience.basis: Open standards and broad portfolio provide resilience, but custom/vertically integrated fabrics are credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Strong liquidity and Taiwan ecosystem investment support execution, but cited evidence does not establish diversified manufacturing/supplier resilience; uncertainty is retained conservatively.

pricingPower.basis: GAAP gross margin remained 73.3% in Q2 and 74.6% for six months despite rapid scaling, evidencing strong economics; however Q2 margin fell 250 bps YoY from lower-margin hardware mix and warrants, so pricing power is not treated as unconstrained.

riskEvidence.basis: Strong liquidity and realized growth offset demanding valuation, working-capital expansion, customer/platform concentration, qualification/ramp execution, margin mix pressure and merchant-silicon substitution.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Recent SEC 10-Q, current proxy and issuer product disclosures cover all operating/governance factors; two distinct external market feeds corroborate current price/market-cap. Competitive share and supplier diversification remain explicit non-gating unknowns.

riskEvidence.basis: Liquidity/growth offset valuation, concentration, execution, working-capital, margin-mix and substitution risk.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current SEC operating/governance filings plus current external market observations; residual competitive/supplier unknowns preserved.

scoreRecord.thesis: Astera Labs is rapidly scaling a high-margin connectivity platform across AI fabric, signal-conditioning and memory bottlenecks with strong liquidity and near-term product ramps; the core limitation is a valuation already discounting substantial success plus substitution/concentration risk.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Demanding valuation combined with hyperscaler/platform concentration, custom-silicon substitution, execution risk and gross-margin mix pressure can create severe downside if growth conversion disappoints.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Filed Q3 2026 results validating whether Scorpio X-Series became the largest product family and whether the ramp sustained growth/margins.

risks.risk: Receivables and inventory expanded sharply during the growth ramp; cash conversion remains to be demonstrated.
Custom silicon and vertical integration can substitute for merchant connectivity content.
Current valuation embeds substantial future growth and increases downside asymmetry on execution misses.

contradictions.claim: Rapid revenue growth versus sharply higher receivables/inventory
contradictions.resolution: Both are supported by the same filed period; retain working-capital build as a risk/watch item rather than negating realized growth.

contradictions.claim: High gross margin versus Q2 margin compression
contradictions.resolution: 73.3% remains high in absolute terms, while the 250-bp YoY decline is explicitly reflected by keeping pricingPower below top-band and retaining mix pressure as a risk.

unknowns.unknown: Q3 realized Scorpio mix and production conversion are not yet established by a filed quarter.
Supplier/manufacturing diversification is not sufficiently established in this evidence set.
Independent evidence of durable competitive share is limited; issuer market-leadership claims are not used to inflate the score.
